# Truefox AI Inc.

> Canada-headquartered applied AI engineering with an India delivery centre, serving international organizations.

Canonical website: https://www.truefoxaiinc.com
Contact: info@truefoxaiinc.com
Headquarters: Suite 300, 72 Victoria Street South, Kitchener, Ontario N2G 4Y9, Canada

## Core capabilities
- Computer vision and real-time video analytics
- Machine learning and predictive analytics
- Generative AI and private enterprise assistants
- Agentic AI systems with human governance
- Biometric identity, attendance, liveness and anti-spoofing
- IoT, embedded systems and edge AI
- Web, mobile, cloud and custom product engineering
- Research, feasibility studies and rapid prototyping
